tldr: Morning batch (Sep 7) — OpenAI's Sunday transparency drop dominates a quiet overnight. The lab says it reached its 'automated research intern' milestone (multi-day agentic tasks under human direction; median researcher now runs >$600/day of inference, 3.1 agent-workdays per human day) and reveals it paused RL training on deployment-bound models after July's research-infra breach. Chief scientist Jakub Pachocki's 'An Alien Mind' essay goes further: capability jumps 'of equal or larger magnitude,' self-driven development, and safety bars that are 'widely mandated,' not voluntary. Anthropic's $1.5B copyright settlement starts paying out and authors push back — publishers claim books whose rights reverted years ago while literary agencies with no rights demand cuts; an arbitrator decides ~482K titles. Jensen Huang calls GPT-6 Astra's 100K+ GB200 training run 'AGI has arrived' — but the 400K extra GPUs carry no buyer, site or date, a capacity story more than a model story.

articles.title: OpenAI hits its 'automated research intern' goal — and reveals an RL-training pause
articles.summary: Rare Sunday transparency drop: multi-day agentic research tasks now work under human direction, but OpenAI paused RL training on deployment-bound models after July's research-infra breach.

articles.title: Pachocki's 'An Alien Mind': capability jumps, self-driven development, mandated safety bars
articles.summary: OpenAI's chief scientist argues capability jumps 'of equal or larger magnitude' are ahead, development becomes self-driven, and safety bars must be 'widely mandated' — not voluntary.

articles.title: Authors push back as publishers and agents grab for Anthropic's $1.5B payout
articles.summary: July-approved settlement is paying out; authors say publishers claim reverted-rights books (April Henry vs HarperCollins) while rights-free agencies demand cuts. Arbitrator decides ~482K titles.

articles.title: Huang: 'AGI has arrived' — Astra trained on 100K+ GB200s, 400K more coming
articles.summary: Nvidia CEO's Sunday reply: 'From ChatGPT to o1 to Astra in 4 years. AGI has arrived.' But the 400K extra GPUs carry no buyer, site or date — capacity and power are the real story.
